Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 12, "heading": "CHAPTER X", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u012-r0030", "target": "Почтительно поклонившись старику, который не мог видеть, но по остро натренированному слуху и по сознательно рассчитанному ритму каждого её движения знал, что она поклонилась, молодая женщина приподняла занавес из одеял и вышла на дневной свет. По обе стороны входа в пещеру сидело по человеку из пеонов. Каждый был вооружён винтовкой и мачете, а за поясами у них торчали ножи без ножен. По приказу девушки оба встали и поклонились — не ей, а приказу и незримому источнику приказа. Один из них постучал тыльной стороной мачете по камню, на котором сидел, затем приложил ухо к камню и стал слушать. В действительности камень был лишь выходом рудной жилы, что тянулась поперёк и сквозь самое сердце горы. А дальше, на противоположном склоне, в орлином гнезде, откуда открывалась великолепная панорама спускающихся склонов Кордильер, сидел другой пеон, который сперва слушал, прижав ухо к такому же рудоносному кварцу, а затем простучал ответ мачете. После этого он отошёл на полдюжины шагов к высокому, наполовину мёртвому дереву, сунул руку в его пустое нутро и потянул за верёвку внутри — так тянет человек, звонящий в колокол на колокольне.", "source_sha256": "96b8868429c10ed936d00010cb396f0e14516923428dfa6fbbc381fcf809a507", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u012-r0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d350332c4e84ca1cc05595fab75e72ba276620fb9e0444bf8c278f482c440e7e"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u012-r0031", "target": "Но никакого звука не раздалось. Вместо этого высокая ветвь в пятидесяти футах над его головой, торчавшая из ствола, как рука семафора, двинулась вверх и вниз — ибо и была рукой семафора. В двух милях оттуда, на гребне горы, ветвь такого же семафорного дерева ответила. А ещё дальше, ниже по склонам, блеск ручного зеркальца на солнце передал гелиографом дальше сообщение слепого из пещеры. И вся эта часть Кордильер стала многословной от шифрованной речи вибрирующих рудных жил, солнечных вспышек и машущих древесных ветвей.", "source_sha256": "0b43961c2691b60628e310be977646be9b7c2879ec5b080e5f57c37767f301da", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u012-r0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "6e2a73bb471daa6f92dfeb4d94a2bb1b9dc06809efac813871c3def59a341be2"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u012-r0032", "tag": "p", "text": "While Enrico Solano, slenderly erect on his horse as an Indian youth and convoyed on either side by his sons, Alesandro and Ricardo, hanging to his saddle trappings, made the best of the time afforded them by Francis’ rearguard battle with the gendarmes, Leoncia, on her mount, and Henry Morgan, lagged behind. One or the other was continually glancing back for the sight of Francis overtaking them. Watching his opportunity, Henry took the back-trail. Five minutes afterward, Leoncia, no less anxious than he for Francis’ safety, tried to turn her horse about. But the animal, eager for the companionship of its mate ahead, refused to obey the rein, cut up and pranced, and then deliberately settled into a balk. Dismounting and throwing her reins on the ground in the Panamanian method of tethering a saddle horse, Leoncia took the back-trail on foot. So rapidly did she follow Henry, that she was almost treading on his heels when he encountered Francis and the peon. The next moment, both Henry and Francis were chiding her for her conduct; but in both their voices was the involuntary tenderness of love, which pleased neither to hear the other uttering.", "sha256": "55f33f10a43f2e75f204ae696a6bd9790313e3e8f6cb3be42ba8cff518c9ae50", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[940]", "source_html": "

While Enrico Solano, slenderly erect on his horse as an Indian youth and convoyed on either side by his sons, Alesandro and Ricardo, hanging to his saddle trappings, made the best of the time afforded them by Francis’ rearguard battle with the gendarmes, Leoncia, on her mount, and Henry Morgan, lagged behind. One or the other was continually glancing back for the sight of Francis overtaking them. Watching his opportunity, Henry took the back-trail. Five minutes afterward, Leoncia, no less anxious than he for Francis’ safety, tried to turn her horse about. But the animal, eager for the companionship of its mate ahead, refused to obey the rein, cut up and pranced, and then deliberately settled into a balk. Dismounting and throwing her reins on the ground in the Panamanian method of tethering a saddle horse, Leoncia took the back-trail on foot. So rapidly did she follow Henry, that she was almost treading on his heels when he encountered Francis and the peon. The next moment, both Henry and Francis were chiding her for her conduct; but in both their voices was the involuntary tenderness of love, which pleased neither to hear the other uttering.

Despite the fact that they had thus captured the runaway peon, whom they proceeded to kick and cuff, all would have been well with Leoncia and the two Morgans had the owner of the peon, the old-time friend of the Solano family, been present. But an attack of the malarial fever, which was his due every third day, had stretched him out in a chill near the burning oilfield.", "sha256": "d1df7b87c5c3c267ad00ad94e1f5460d6d710c50458fa661ce40dbe7cbc47526", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[941]", "source_html": "

But upon the peon, with Latin-American cruelty, they continued to reiterate their rage.", "sha256": "7f42d2257fafac99769be8164dc9202a10d7e9f40622dca6fd5d9d1a3b26bbf1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[942]", "source_html": "

Shouts of joy heralded the debouchment upon the scene of the Jefe’s gendarmes and of the Jefe and Alvarez Torres. Arose at once the rapid-fire, staccato, bastard-Latin of all men of both parties of pursuers, trying to explain and demanding explanation at one and the same time. And while the farrago of all talking simultaneously and of no one winning anywhere in understanding, made anarchy of speech, Torres, with a nod to Francis and a sneer of triumph to Henry, ranged before Leoncia and bowed low to her in true and deep hidalgo courtesy and respect.", "sha256": "fe10e1075e7dc6125d7aa73d2019b55c51f8aff1742b5cc75bf5fcf49f6f4dbb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[943]", "source_html": "

Yet were they destined to arrive nowhere, by themselves, with their captives. Shouts of joy heralded the debouchment upon the scene of the Jefe’s gendarmes and of the Jefe and Alvarez Torres. And while the farrago of all talking simultaneously and of no one winning anywhere in understanding, made anarchy of speech, Torres, with a nod to Francis and a sneer of triumph to Henry, ranged before Leoncia and bowed low to her in true and deep hidalgo courtesy and respect.
